steps.en: Install locally, define series and authorize channel logins
steps.zh: 本地安装，定义系列并授权频道登录

steps.en: Curate topics and retain research in content cards
steps.zh: 精选选题，在内容卡保存调研

steps.en: Choose an idea and review the script direction
steps.zh: 选择题目并审核脚本方向

steps.en: Run production skills and prepare video with platform copy
steps.zh: 执行制作技能，生成视频与平台文案

steps.en: Approve the film and choose publishing or manual handoff
steps.zh: 确认成片，选择发布或手动交接

steps.en: Send approved content through selected platform adapters
steps.zh: 通过所选平台适配器发送获准内容

value.en: One local record connects research, production and an explicit publishing decision
value.zh: 用本地记录串起调研、制作与明确发布决定
